As far as the age of the earth, you have to understand Hebrew and re-read Genesis. How can you, as a scientist, not believe in a creator?  The closer you look. The more it points to one.

@BridgetJentzsch @scoshow23 @JackPosobiec There are evidence of floods in many places especially as people settle near rivers.  It would take 4 times as much water as exists on Earth to flood the earth to the height of Mt Everest so a global flood is impossible and doesn't show up in Antarctic ice cores 100K years old.
